text:
maya (People Ops): planning a 'Welcome Cup' onboarding kit for new hires joining in May. includes mug, welcome card, and quick benefits cheat-sheet. want to sync with hiring ops for timing + cost.

trent (Hiring Ops): sounds good. estimated take: 60 new hires across locations. do we have preferred vendor for mugs?

zoe (Recruiting): we usually use brandedmugs.co but they require min order 100. could do 2 runs or pick a universal travel mug to avoid min.

maya (People Ops): budget ask: $22 per kit (mug $10, card $1, benefits card + packing $11 incl shipping) => $1320 total. Requesting approval from finance.

rachel (Finance): need a line itemized PO and confirmation of headcount by region for shipping calc. if we do EU/APAC shipping, customs & VAT add ~12%.

trent (Hiring Ops): headcount by region: US 35, EU 18, APAC 7. will confirm hires by 1975003000.

maya (People Ops): packaging note: keep it small for remote onboarding. include QR code that links to benefits portal. printable insert must be 2-sided.

zoe (Recruiting): recruiting will coordinate local handoff for regional offices. for APAC, may prefer digital e-gift card instead of physical due to customs.

packing-bot: reminder scheduled ">1975003000<" send final headcount CSV and approve PO.

maya (People Ops): ok will proceed after headcount confirmed. I can create the benefits cheat-sheet draft for review by 1975002000.

rachel (Finance): provisional approval pending final PO & VAT calc.

maya (People Ops): thanks all. I'll update here when art and final numbers are in.
